headline: Oily Water Separator: The 15 ppm Rule
insight: MARPOL Annex I allows machinery-space bilge discharge only en route, through approved equipment, at 15 ppm or less without dilution. Record every operation in the Oil Record Book.

meta.description: The oily water separator and the 15 ppm limit of MARPOL Annex I: when bilge water may be discharged and why the Oil Record Book matters.
